verdict.rationale: Anytype doesn't ship a native in-app AI-insights feature, but its local API + official MCP server + 'Agents Skill' let external AI assistants (Claude, Cursor, Gemini CLI, etc.) read, search, and run scripts against a user's Anytype data to generate insights/suggestions, and Queries provide auto-updating views of the knowledge base. This is enablement via integration rather than a built-in 'AI-generated insights' feature inside the product itself. Missing for 10: no evidence of a native, first-party AI panel/chat that autonomously surfaces insights without wiring up an external agent, and no independent hands-on account of the agent-generated insights actually working well.
